notes.title: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery – Celebrating One Year with You!
notes.content:
Dear Agents, today marks the first anniversary of the Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. Welcome back!

Over the past year, everyone has worked hard on various missions. The headquarters’ tent has now been freshly decorated for the anniversary and a special feast has also been prepared for all Agents. Come on in and join us for a taste!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/227b12d663a3c74c0a100c437148f1d0e9198ed8.jpg
Mendo: Today’s flavors are so rich and layered! 😮
Jefuty: Huff, puff…

Jefuty Figurine Pre-Order Live on March 26th
Want to catch a glimpse of Jefuty’s gallant presence at any time?
Here she comes—striding towards us through the wind and snow. The official Jefuty figurine is arriving, and its price is as lovely as Jefuty herself. Pre-order and receive an adorable bonus chibi character pendant. Agents, get your Jefuty home starting from March 26th!
More details and images here:

It’s Jefuty! Our hero is here!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/af64ec23b64a746fc837c2dad1d554f05d12474e.jpg
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/3f2b471a4e03b343c313009f9ad7801746d5df4d.png
Acrylic pendant, one of three randomly (Jefuty, Lige, or Noylu)
*Images are for reference only; the pendant will be shipped with the figurine after full payment.

Recently, headquarters has received exquisite fan art from players around the globe, which we’re excited to share with you (just a few to keep it short). Feel free to claim credit or link more in the comments below.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/542f4a4409e9cb33c79fcdefa9a874e6213aad23.pngBy-Zanzibarland

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/e813fc4d2be298a5b0f5b49d1d9b18ab2e667976.pngBy-诗翼茉翔

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/59e053487ba233a6446980101ad5d9e997491adf.png
By-raycw

Of course, besides fan art, there are also cosplays, MDD, montages, fan fiction and so much more!
Our beloved@猫圆圆Sonoko

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35502287/ac415de9228d4665c74935c3ef51b392d38b553b.png

Am I hallucinating?
Is that Jefuty… dancing?
By-电子妖精-扎克斯

[Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery] Here's to you
By-Welyeker

Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery Tinder Operation (Compilation)
By-微光

The anniversary fan art contest is still ongoing. For detailed event arrangements, please refer to our previous post. We look forward to even more amazing works flooding into headquarters! All-time low discount and a limited-time DEMO are also still available until March 28.

During the anniversary celebration, we are hosting various special events irregularly in our Discord and on social media. So feel free to drop by and join us!

It’s snowing like the first day we met, and with that begins our steadfast comradeship, thank you for being with us all along. Agents, happy first anniversary!

notes.title: 1st Anniversary is here! - Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium collab & Fan Art Contest
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!
Time flies, it has been nearly a year since the release of Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. Through the dedication of every agent, whether on the front lines or supporting from behind, we have persevered together. We sincerely appreciate your contributions!

As the first anniversary approaches on March 22, the Command Headquarters has prepared a series of events for all agents. We invite you to share the lasting memories of your Code Name Bakery journey with us through the Anniversary Fan Art Contest!

Also, Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery will participate in the Steam Spring Sale. From March 13 to March 27 (PST), we will offer an all-time low discount of 25% OFF for two weeks. A free demo will also be available during this period. Look forward to welcoming new agents to experience and join Code Name Bakery!

Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium & Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery 1st Anniversary Collab, Parallel Operation, on the horizon!
To celebrate the 1st anniversary of Reverse Collapse, we're excited to team up with the Steam version of Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium for a special collaboration. We’d really love for all the commanders from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium to drop by and give Bakery’s demo a try.

📅Rewards Claiming Period: 3/13 20:00 - 3/27 9:00 (PST)
📌You can snag some awesome tactical supply rewards in Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium. Simply type the redeem code：1YRBAKERY in the settings menu during the event. For all the details, please check in game.
>>Commander Trail Entrance<<

1st Anniversary Fan Art Contest Starting Soon
Since the release, we’ve been blown away by all the amazing fan creations you’ve shared. With our first anniversary coming, we’d love to keep fueling your creative spirit. That’s why the Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery fan art contest is about to kick off in style! From March 14 to March 30 (PST), post any fan art related to Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery on any platform and you could win Steam gift cards and key codes. Check out the details below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/5968096dfabfb6b1fb031addc078e64255e0ea54.png
==Event Details==

 What to Post: Create fan content inspired by Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. This can be in any form, videos, hand-drawn art, montages, fan fiction, illustrations (comics, just art, memes, etc.). The theme, idea, and style are totally up to you!
 Where to Post: You can share your work on any social media platform you’re comfortable with. Whether that’s X, TikTok, Reddit, Pixiv, Instagram, or anywhere else you usually post.

==How to Participate==
[olist]
 During the event, post your creation on any social media platform (including but not limited to X, TikTok, Reddit, Pixiv, and Instagram) using the hashtags #ReverseCollapse and #ReverseCollapseAnniversary, then publish your post.
 Click the Submission Form link to fill out the form and submit your entry, and that’s all it takes!
[/olist]
==Prizes==

 Grand Prize (3 winners): One $150 Steam Gift Card + one Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery – Deluxe Edition redeem code
 Excellence Prize (5 winners): One $100 Steam Gift Card + one Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery – Deluxe Edition redeem code
 Lucky Draw Prize (10 winners, randomly selected from all valid entries): One $10 Steam Gift Card + one Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery – Deluxe Edition redeem code


 Submitted works must be related to Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery and must not contain illegal, violent, pornographic, offensive, inflammatory, or advertising content, nor violate the community guidelines of the respective platform.
 Submissions must be original. Plagiarism, reposting, use of unauthorized materials, or AI-generated content will be disqualified. For collaborative works, please designate a single account for submission. Duplicate submissions from multiple users are not allowed.
 Our team will evaluate submissions based on creativity, quality, engagement metrics, and other factors to determine winners. The results will be publicly announced.
 The event awards are granted based on the submitted works and do not represent endorsement of the winner's past statements or views from our team.
 Copyright of the submitted works remains with the original creators. By participating in the event, you agree to allow the Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery official team to use the works for non-commercial promotional purposes with proper attribution.
 The final interpretation rights of this event belong to the official Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery team.

An unforgettable journey wouldn’t be possible without the creativity and support of our agents. We can’t wait to see your amazing creations and wild ideas!

As we celebrate our first anniversary, if you have anything to say about Reverse Collapse, feel free to drop a comment under any post of our social media or leave your message in our Discord.

Thank you again for your support and company over the past year. Here’s to our journey ahead being fun and smooth!

notes.title: 【Points shop items Now Out】Discount Incoming! & 5.10 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings, dear agents!

We’ve just released a new update, fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below. Plus, mark your calendars for our upcoming week-long Discount, offering 18% OFF from May 11 to May 18, with trading cards and points shop items available at the same time. Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our official Discord and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

[New Additions]
1.Trading cards and points shop items will be available at 17:00 (GMT) on May 10.
●11 new trading cards.
●New Steam points shop items: 3 animated avatars, 3 avatar frames, 10 profile backgrounds, 7 mini-profile backgrounds, 6 animated stickers and 10 emoticons.

[Fixes]
1.Fixed an issue where entering and then skipping cutscenes while skill animation is still being played may cause the cutscene to freeze.
2.Fixed an SFX glitch when Mendo in Stealth Mode uses the skill “Silencing Strike”.
3.Fixed an issue in Chapter 2, Act 6: Approach: Bonus Objective “Pick up all supplies” doesn’t include the supply in the lower middle part of the map.
4.Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Dead End: Map Details in Preparation Phase contains redundant “Marzanna” Unmanned Drone(s).
5.Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem: Shrike Mitotic Specimen may have wrong patrol route after allied units got spotted.
6.Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, Act 3: Die Another Day Phase 3: Mendo using ultimate skill “Mechanical Rampage” could cause the game to stuck.
7.Fixed an issue when directly entering the main menu of “Bakery Girl 2092R” mode after starting the game may cause controllers to stop working.
8.Fixed an issue where accessory “Suppressor” is not functioning in “Bakery Girl 2092R”.
9.Fixed an issue in “Bakery Girl 2092R”: After the opening cutscene of Chapter 3: Escape from Death, the “Skip” button may remain visible.
10.Fixed an issue when entering Phase 7 of “Bakery Girl 2092R” Chapter 8: Truth of Betrayal, units may overlap.
11.Fixed some art asset errors.
12.Fixed some text errors.

Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our official Discord and report them. [olist]
 Adjusted the condition of achievement “Supreme Technology” to “Raise the Tech Level to Rank 7”. If already reached Rank 7 before the update, loading corresponding save files will trigger the achievement.
[/olist]
[Fixes]
[olist]

notes.title: 04-19 Patch Note
notes.content:
Greetings, dear agents!
We will be rolling out an update addressing the adjustments to the “stealth experience” and “Casual Mode”, while fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below.

Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our official Discord and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

04-19 Patch Notes
[Stealth Related Adjustments]
[olist]
 Added target selection tips when checking the locations and moving routes of enemy searchlights.
 Added item trait “Enemy Detection” to “Scanner” and “Advanced Scanner”. It will increase view range at the start of each turn and can be triggered up to 2 times.
 Chapter 4: The Rescue: Items preventing characters from getting exposed are not disabled anymore.
 The SP cost of Mendo’s skill “Silencing Strike” is adjusted to 0, and if enemy is not defeated after use, the target will enter “Asleep” status, reducing evasion by 50.
 Item “Sonar Scanner” is now available for Item Production in the Preparation Phase of Chapter 2, Act 6: Approach. For save files already unlocked this act, loading to any Preparation Phase or selecting “Restart Battle” during missions will also enable Item Production of the item.
 Added new item “Detection Interference Program”, which will reduce all of enemy’s normal visual range to Anti-Stealth Visual Range after use for one turn. This item is limited and can be obtained in certain missions.
 Adjusted Chapter 2, Act 9: Hunting Game and Chapter 4: Deep in the Tiger's Den: If player’s units are not exposed before entering the base, then the searchlight routes can be viewed after entering the base.
 Adjusted certain terrain that may affect gameplay experience in Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem.
[/olist]
[Casual Mode Related Adjustments]
In order to create a more relaxing gaming experience for players not very familiar with SLG or SRPG, we’ve made some new adjustments to the “Casual” mode of the game:
[olist]
 Added “Casual²” mode: After selecting “Casual” mode when starting a new game, players will have the option to enable “Casual²” mode. When this mode is selected, players will gain additional healing items “Pill” in every mission. And in battles, allied units will be healed 50% of their Max HP at the start of each turn (excluding certain special missions). Players already started the game can also switch to “Casual²” mode through “Menu - Select Difficulty”.
 More experience after finishing missions in the early stage of the game.
 More experience after finishing Training Simulations.
 Enemy Bosses have 30% less attack, -30 Accuracy and -15 Evasion (excluding Super Mutant Lambda, Reflection of the Progenitor and False Heart).
 In the first playthrough, the Level Cap of Team is set to 70.
[/olist]
[Other Adjustments and Optimization]
[olist]
 Adjusted “Standard” mode to allow unlimited manual saves each turn.
 Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Now “Autonomous Recon Vehicle” cannot gain access to “Bridge Terminal Passcode”. Prior to the update, doing so will cause the game to stuck.
 Chapter 2, Act 9: Hunting Game: After finishing the objectives in the first phase, during the cutscene all deployed Equipment-type Items will be returned to the backpack. Prior to the update, enemies discovering Equipment-type Items could cause errors in the cutscene played after.
 Added voice when Tactical Dolls, Beria, Kirill, Lige (in special missions) and some enemy bosses use certain skills.
 Adjusted the Carrying Capacity of item “Pill” in backpack to 99.
 Optimized the performance when Atena, Jevon and Carl are defeated with Puppet status.
 Optimized some art assets.
[/olist]
[Fixes]
[olist]
 Fixed an error where Mendo’s skill “Silencing Strike” could cause incorrect damage.
 Fixed an issue where Atena’s trait “Steady” doesn’t stop Ability Decrease caused by enemy trait “Shrike Diffusion”.
 Fixed a bug when occasionally dragging the item “Pill” around in Battle Backpack may cause the game to freeze. 
 Fixed a problem where items “Blood Bullet” and “Soporific Dart” don’t have shooting animation when used by Betty, Abigail, Ruby and Valmet.
 Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances players won’t be able to continue playing the game for a while after using “Shockwave Grenade” and blowing enemy units away.
 Fixed missing on-hit animation when “Reflection of the Progenitor” is attacked by “Electric Turret”.
 Fixed an issue where the Details page of Blood Cocoons doesn’t have the trait “Bloody Assimilation”.
 Fixed incomplete skill description of “Jamming Area” owned by “Wide Area Electronic Jammer”.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Certain enemies in the stronghold may wrongly switch their behavior modes.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Occasionally the story after finishing the first phase cannot be skipped.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, Act 7: Trap: “Cruise Missile” cannot be used to destroy Energy Supply Room.
 Fixed some terrain deployment errors in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup.
 Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup Second Phase: After choosing to retreat, the disabled items are incorrect.
 Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup Second Phase: After choosing to retreat, Battlefield Preparation doesn’t have Recommended Items.
 Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: Certain units will still trigger and start dialog after defeated.
 Fixed some missing cutscene sound effects in Chapter 4: The Rescue.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Caged Bird: When entering the battlefield for a very short moment Skyscraper can be seen as already destroyed.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem: When players’ units are discovered by the enemies, the visual range of Shrike Mitotic Specimens is not changed to Recon.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Eviction Notice: Units may overlap in the final cutscene.
 Fixed an issue where players cannot enter Chapter 5, Act 1: The Grateful Dead after watching the opening story of Chapter 5.
 Chapter 5, Act 2: Suburban Defense: Fixed missing special effects when enemy-controlled “Sphinx” City Defense Battery attacks.
 Chapter 5, Act 2: Suburban Defense: Fixed a SFX glitch when “Sphinx” City Defense Battery attacks, and missing SFX when player-controlled City Defense Battery rotates.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, Act 2: Suburban Defense: if Oleg is defeated before Sugar Σ shows up and then skip the story, the event of Sugar Σ controlling City Defense Battery will be wrongly triggered beforehand. 
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 5, Act 3: Die Another Day: Bonus Objective doesn’t count “Oil Tanker” detonated by item “Incendiary Grenade”. 
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled: Jefuty only has one weapon in the second playthrough.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled: In Pre-Battle Preparation “Equipment Crafting” menu can be incorrectly opened in the second playthrough.
 Fixed an issue in “Bakery Girl 2092R” Chapter 9: Blood for Blood: Noylu’s evasion cannot be reduced.
 Fixed some missing sound effects when holding to skip certain in-battle stories for controller users.
 Fixed a problem where story “Skip” button is incorrectly displayed for controller users.
 Fixed an issue where the two function buttons of checking summoned unit and switching Temporary Backpack conflict in Battlefield Preparation phase for controller users.
 Fixed an issue where controller users are not able to select traits using controllers in Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled.
 Fixed an issue where occasionally logos are not shown when the game starts.
 Fixed missing SFX when “Electric Turret” is attacking “Reflection of the Progenitor”.
 Fixed a SFX glitch where SFX will continue to play after skipping a cutscene while “Marzanna” Unmanned Drone and “Filins” Unmanned Drone are moving.
 Fixed a SFX glitch when “Jarilo” Combat Train’s trait “Tracking Shot” is triggered.
 Fixed some art asset errors.
 Fixed some text errors.
[/olist]

notes.title: 04-13 patch note
notes.content:
[Fixes]
Fixed an issue where items disabled in the first phase of Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape are not enabled in the second and third phases.

notes.title: Apr. 12th Patch Note - Art Book Expansion & Movement Confirmation Mode
notes.content:
Greetings, dear agents!
We will be rolling out an update today. As discussed in previous announcements, it includes Art Book expansion, a new “Movement Confirmation Mode” for Keyboard & Mouse, and fixes addressing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below.

Apr. 12th Patch Notes:
[New Additions]
[olist]
 Art Book has 54 new pages now, to a total of 124 pages.
 Added a new “Movement Confirmation Mode” option for Keyboard & Mouse: if “Double-Click” is selected, the movement action will only be performed after double clicking the Left Mouse Button on the target tile.
[/olist]
[Optimizations and Adjustments]
[olist]
 Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem: It is now allowed to get exposed. The first three Phase Objectives were adjusted to “All Shrike Mitotic Specimens and Lige are either defeated or hypnotized by the Hypnotic Trap”, the Victory Objective in the final phase remains the same.
 Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: the first phase and Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: the second phase: Items preventing characters from getting exposed are not disabled anymore. Chapter 4: The Rescue will be adjusted in the next update.
 Chapter 5, Act 3: Die Another Day: the first phase: After Atena finishing the Phase Objective and reaching the airport control tower, this location won’t have URNC soldiers turning into puppets.
 Chapter 3, Act 5: Base Infiltration and Chapter 4: Night Scouting: For controller users the cursor will be hovering over Carl by default when turn starts. 
 When using preparation menu during battles to enter “Collection - Battle Records”, the viewing story replay function is now disabled. Before the update, this could cause some UI errors.
 Starting from the 2nd playthrough, save files of Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled Preparation Phase can not be inherited anymore. Inheriting the save was causing data error before the update.
 Optimized some SFX volume.
 Enhanced several textures and art.
[/olist]
[Fixes]
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where defeating Blood Cocoon or Blood Cocoon defeating wrapped units will cause the game to freeze.
 Fixed an issue that controller users are not able to select certain sentences when viewing voice replay.
 Fixed an issue that “Medium Turret” doesn’t consumes AP when using Stealth.
 Fixed an issue that occasionally Electric Turret’s attack won’t change enemy unit's behavior mode  to “attack”.
 Fixed effective range description error in Lige’s skill: Made in Hell.
 Fixed an issue where Blood Mist was still generated after defeating Blood Cocoon using high level “Blood Bullet”. 
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, Act 4: Camouflage: players’ normal attack will still have 0% chance to hit certain “Elite Scouts” after their “Dodge” status is gone. 
 Fixed an issue where blood blister doesn’t properly showup after defeating TASA Puppet for the first time and skipping the cutscene in Chapter 3, Act 8: Battle of the Peak.
 Fixed an issue where equipment-type items deployed on the battlefield won’t return to the Backpack in the last cutscene in Chapter 4: Deviation.
 Fixed an issue where enemy’s visual range is not reduced after triggering certain special event in Chapter 4: The Rescue second phase.
 Fixed a problem where reconnaissance equipment won’t return to the backpack after triggering certain special event in Chapter 4: The Rescue second phase.
 Fixed issues in Chapter 4: Snow Mountain Interception and Enticement: The effect of Jevon’s Ultimate Skill happening in the cutscene will be carried to the real battle.
 Fixed an issue when Field Surveying Chapter 4: Forward Pressure during preparation phase, certain “AA-03 Autonomous Mechs” were not properly shown.
 Fixed an issue when sometimes flamethrowers used by TASA members will be aiming at a wrong direction in the cutscene of Chapter 4: The Final Battle II.
 Fixed a terrain description error of the “Booby-Trap” created by enemies in Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled.
 Fixed an issue where “Simple Turret” will appear in the Synthesis Catalog when playing “Bakery Girl 2092R” Chapter 2: The First Battle.
 Fixed an issue that level 4 “Rocket Launcher” doesn’t cause splash damage when destroying “URNC Transporter” in Chapter 3, Act 4: Camouflage.
 Starting from the 2nd playthrough, “Advanced Upgrade Blueprint” dropped by β Shrike was missing in Chapter 3, Act 8: Battle of the Peak. It’s now fixed and if you’ve defeated the Boss before, loading the save after this patch will grant the missing blueprint(s).
 Fixed an issue where certain achievement are not triggered when after the first playthrough.
 Fixed an counting error of achievement “Overtime”.
 Fixed Steam achievement description errors of “Deep in the Tiger's Den” and “No Escape”.
 Fixed an issue where Confidential Files - Code Name Operation Bakery Report is not counted towards corresponding achievement. After the update, players own this file will have it added to the achievement count.
 Fixed SFX issues where Jefuty’s first voice-overs in all of her confession part in Chapter 4 were not played correctly.  
 Fixed an issue where certain SFX were not adjusted by changing “SETTINGS - Audio and Visual Settings - SFX Volume”.
 Fixed missing SFX when Ruby uses skill “Coordinated Signal”.
 Fixed missing SFX when Mendo uses skill “Harmonic Resonance”.
 Fixed a SFX glitch when using a higher level version of Jefuty’s Ultimate Skill “Declaration of Miracle”.
 Fixed an issue where the SFX and music in battle were not suspended after entering the victory scene in Chapter 4: Blood Horror and Chapter 4: Nightmare.
 Fixed a SFX glitch when Commando uses skill “High-Explosive Squash Head” in Chapter 5, Act 1: The Grateful Dead.
 Fixed certain textures and art errors.
 Fixed some text errors.
[/olist]

Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our official Discord and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

notes.title: April 3rd Update
notes.content:
Greetings Agents,

We're excited to announce the latest update, freshly rolled out today! This update brings along a brand new feature - the ability to playback voice recordings in the log interface. Additionally, we've made some necessary fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. For a detailed overview of the changes, please refer to the patch notes below.

As always, if you encounter any issues while playing, don't hesitate to reach out to us through our official Discord. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us swiftly address any concerns. Thank you for your continued support and patience.


04-03 patch note

[New Features]

notes.title: （updated）03-29 RC patch note
notes.content:
Hello agents,

Today we will be rolling out an update addressing the significant adjustments to the stealth missions, as communicated in our previous developer logs, and fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage and is expected to be released later today. You can find detailed update information and stealth mission adjustments in the patch note below.

Patch Notes:

New Additions:
[olist]
 Added animation skip function: The game's setting intro animation in the beginning and the opening animation when entering Chapter 2 can now be skipped.
 Added a failsafe mechanism for "Blood Bullets" data errors. After the update, if you encounter this issue, reloading your last save should fix this issue. The root cause of this issue is still under investigation, and a complete fix will be included in future updates.
 Added the "Quick confirm with Controller" option in settings. Enabling this option allows actions like "entering stealth" and "repairing" to be executed without a second confirmation, only available for controllers.
[/olist]

Stealth Mission Optimization: 
We conducted the first round of optimization on stealth missions. Most missions now can be completed with direct combat strategies. However, to balance stealth and combat, choosing combat in stealth missions may trigger enemy reinforcements on some maps. Notably, the "Duty Room" in the base functions as originally implemented, dispatching enemy troops upon player unit detection or enemy alert. Please refer to the following for specific adjustments. All adjusted campaign missions can still be completed by stealth.
 Chapter 2-6: Struggle for Survival: Adjusted to allow detection, with all enemy units lowered to level 13, and victory conditions unchanged. Also, a hidden shortcut is added at release, go explore! 

 Chapter 2-9: Hunting Game: Adjusted to allow detection. After players being exposed, the base will receive several enemy reinforcements, with victory conditions changed to all units reaching the designated location in the upper left corner of the map. Note that players lack means to confront the "Svarog" heavy tank on the right at this point in the playthrough. Additionally, the enemy commander's "Office Keycard" can be obtained by defeating them post-update.

 Chapter 3-1: Night Crisis: Upgraded the lighting equipment in the amusement park.

 Chapter 3-5: Base Infiltration: Adjusted to allow Jefuti and Mendo to be detected. Post-exposure, the base's duty room will receive enemy reinforcements, but Carl and the URNC soldiers in the dormitory area won't join the battle. Phase and victory goals remain unchanged. Carl can divert all guards in the upper area in a special way if Jefuti and Mendo remain unexposed. Moreover, the "Experiment Building Keycard" that Karl needs to search for during the campaign will be located at the specified position at the beginning of the second phase post-update. Correct dialogue is no longer required to obtain it, but an orange column of light will appear at the location after the conversation is completed.

 Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: Changed the first phase's goal to "Defeat all enemy units" or "All friendly characters remain unexposed and reach the designated location." Choosing combat will trigger a small wave of enemy reinforcements, while the second phase design remains unchanged.

 Chapter 4: Night Scouting: Adjusted to allow Jefuti and Mendo to be detected. Post-exposure, the base's duty room will receive enemy reinforcements, but Carl won't join the battle. Stage and victory goals remain unchanged.

 Chapter 4: Secret War: Adjusted to allow detection. Choosing combat will trigger a wave of enemy reinforcements, and the URNC transport truck will no longer appear. Victory conditions remain unchanged.

 Chapter 4: The Rescue: Still a mandatory stealth mission, but Carl can divert all stationed units across the map in a special way during the second phase.

 Chapter 5-3: Die Another Day: The interior part remains a mandatory stealth mission, but a hidden shortcut has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/adef922b374f8926069dede512ef02295e6681a4.png

Please note that these adjustments will require re-entering the campaign post-update to take effect. Playing with save files from the original battles may cause some errors. Additionally, adjusting "Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem" presents significant challenges, so adjustments to this mission will be updated in the future.

Other Adjustments and Optimizations
[olist]
 Refined the additional objective descriptions in Chapter 3-4, "Camouflage."
 Streamlined various controller settings:

 Standardized the controls for "Repair" and "Recall" of "Tool" items for controllers.
 Limited the visibility of the "Controller Camera Mode" option to controller mode only.
 Eliminated redundant options such as "Quick Attack" from the controller settings.

 Enhanced the clarity of certain text entries in the Japanese version of "Keyword."
 Improved the readability of selected text entries in the English version of "Keyword."
 Enhanced several textures and art.
 Adjusted the visibility range of map edges for better navigation.
 Special Adjustment: Identified an issue in Chapter 4, "Dead End," where incorrect snow texture on a house in the lower-left corner of the map is causing players to spend excessive time searching for collectibles. As a solution, we've chosen to preserve this distinctive terrain and introduced 12 "Airstrike Missiles" in this area. Following the update, players who have unlocked the "Airstrike Missiles" can explore this stage to obtain resources (limited to one use per playthrough).
[/olist]

Fixes:
[olist]
 Resolved an issue where total playtime is incorrectly displayed in save files.
 Addressed the problem of the "Autonomous Recon Vehicle" can clear the player team's tripwires with the "Trap Disassembly" skill.
 Fixed an inconsistency in Chapter 2-7, "Hell's Paradise," where despite “Lige?” being knocked down by Mendo's "Alert Area" in the first phase, the attack would still inflict damage in the second phase.
 Resolved an issue in Chapter 5-3, "Die Another Day," where the target location lacked directional indicator markings.
 Addressed a problem where enemy units in Search Mode would occasionally circle around our critically wounded units.
 Fixed the inability of "Oryx" and "Melt Bomb" to reduce the armor of "Quarantine Zone Gates" and enemy barrier-type units.
 Rectified various performance issues caused by tripwires during specific scenes.
 Fixed the "Electric Turret" not able to enter Stealth Mode issue.
 Fixed the issue where the replaying the opening animation in "Collection-Battle Records", other background music would still play in the back.
 Resolved an issue where game achievement progression couldn't synchronize with Steam in certain cases.
 Corrected instances where items and skills targeting "Mechanical" units failed to affect Sugar's "Holographic Doppelgangers."
 Fixed an issue where Lige has no breathing animation when in “Mirror Self” outfit.
 Addressed difficulties in hearing the exposed warning alert sound clearly in certain scenarios.
 Corrected discrepancies between sound effects and visuals when the "Svarog" heavy tank launched missiles during specific map events.
 Fixed the reappearance of the UI when taking screenshots using the screenshot key after hiding the UI.
 Resolved issues where players could access "Item Ascension," "Item Production," and "Item Synthesis" in Chapter 4, "Blood Horror."
 Fixed display inconsistencies in various interfaces.
 Corrected errors in some tutorials.
 Addressed animation glitches.
 Resolved the issue of players in the Thailand region being unable to access the game.
 Fixed certain Chinese, Japanese, and English text errors.
[/olist]

This update includes a lot of adjustments. Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our official Discord and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

notes.title: Sneak Peek at What's Next-Developer Diary #4
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow players! 
It's been nearly a week since the official launch of Reverse Collapse, and what a week it's been! We've been thrilled to witness the lively discussions and passionate engagement from players worldwide across various platforms. Your overwhelming attention and support for Reverse Collapse have truly warmed our hearts, and we deeply appreciate every feedback and comment you've shared.

Update and Fix Plan

Since the game's release, we've been rolling out updates to address various concerns, including the much-discussed issue of spoilers popping up for deluxe edition outfits. You can find detailed information on these optimizations in our previous update announcements. Today, we're rolling out another update to address specific issues, which will be outlined in the detailed Patch Notes provided at the end of this post.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/e279f85d7764667aec760d96ee926a67808925a5.png

【Family Sharing Issue】
We've received reports from some players about difficulties in sharing the game with friends. After consulting with Steam and doing thorough research, we've confirmed that Family Sharing is indeed a default feature supported by the platform. We assure you that there are no restrictions from our end on this feature. Any issues that are encountered in this regard have been promptly reported to the Steam support team, and we're actively working with them to fix this. If you're facing similar challenges, please remain patient and feel free to reach out to us via the official discord.


Stealth Level Adjustments
We've heard your feedback regarding the Stealth Levels, and rest assured, we've been hard at work brainstorming solutions since release. While it's not a task that can be accomplished overnight, we're committed to finding the best possible adjustments. For sections of the campaign focused on stealth, we're exploring ways to offer players a choice between stealth and combat. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/00407d4e88b776d0e9c6262f5b4fa472d1a49d52.png

Additionally, we're looking into alternative completion methods for stealth missions that cannot accommodate combat due to underlying design constraints. We'll be conducting testing over the coming days and aim to provide updates later this week. Stay tuned for further details on these adjustments in future update announcements.

Art Book & Points Store
We've received feedback about the Digital Art Book not being comprehensive enough. As a supplementary presentation of the design philosophy behind Reverse Collapse, the Digital Art Book is essential for many players to fully immerse themselves in the game world. Rest assured, we're fully committed to ensuring its quality, with all content specially crafted by our talented artists. Furthermore, we've taken your feedback to heart and are actively working on supplementing the Art Book with additional drawings to provide a more comprehensive overview of the world and design of Reverse Collapse. 

Additionally, we're making progress on the design of items for the Steam Points Store, including avatar borders, stickers, expressions, and more. We anticipate sharing the first batch of these items with you later this week.

More Fan Arts
Back to fan art highlights again, enjoy!

If you encounter any issues while playing, don't hesitate to join our official Discord and provide your feedback. We'll be sure to address them promptly. Thank you for your continued support and understanding.

notes.title: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery is Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings, agents! 

We're thrilled to announce that Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery is officially released today! We extend our sincere gratitude for your enduring support and enthusiasm, especially to those who participated in the public tests, closed betas, and LQAs, providing invaluable feedback. Each piece of input from our dedicated community has been instrumental in shaping the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/756bdc9633b54d950ff0882ee573e2ccd3952997.png
As the first-ever project released by MICAteam, we've endeavored to deliver this once-constrained gem of a game, now fully realized through the remake. While the journey took longer than anticipated, we are ecstatic to finally reach this milestone.

The remake isn't just about sprucing up visuals; it signifies breakthroughs and enhancements across multiple fronts:

【Expanded Storyline & Enriched Details】
The original "Bakery Girl" contained numerous untold stories due to various constraints during development, leaving us with lingering regrets. This remake allowed us to fulfill those unrealized ideas and incorporate many new elements, surpassing even our initial aspirations. With over ten times the script, the remake unveils more plot intricacies and details, breathing new life into the narrative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/512efb02543b8f9cd42849f517c7e8a8d74ef0df.png
【Customizable Tactical Teams for Complex Battles】
The expanded storyline also brings about a significantly increased volume of the main storyline and levels. However, we've crafted each level to ensure they don't feel repetitive. In addition to retaining the stealth and enemy elimination gameplay from the original, we've integrated terrain effects, puzzles, and boss battles to add depth. Furthermore, with added story elements and character development, each character in Reverse Collapse now boasts a unique skill set and expanded equipment options, alongside a broader range of consumables and items. Our aim is to offer players diverse tactical choices, enriching the strategic depth of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/6e7608c89fd595c7d2dbdbc89dfabc99ceb6d6f4.png
While our foremost priority with the remake remains to ensure satisfaction among original players of "Bakery Girl", as a game from MICAteam, we understand the importance of maintaining its inherent challenge and strategic depth. Thus, we've retained challenging S-rank objectives and introduced 100 new in-game achievements, including many hidden ones for you to discover.

【Immersive Cinematic Experience】
From the game's inception, we've strived to enhance visuals and integrate narrative tension into gameplay. Introducing 2D character sprites as the main performers was one such innovation. In addition to standard animations, we've crafted numerous new animations tailored for storytelling and introduced many new illustrations into the game to enhance the experience. Furthermore, we've added Japanese voiceovers to all story levels and key map scenes to ensure players are fully immersed in the narrative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/4e653db6bfd30f885d6b3f5097e24fabf0990781.gif

We believe the remake encapsulates everything essential to the core of this game, presenting not only the complete "Bakery Girl" experience but also a brand-new game, Reverse Collapse. We hope that both seasoned players and newcomers alike will find enjoyment in this adventure.

Addressing Your Questions:

Q: How can I report bugs encountered during gameplay?
A: Should you encounter any issues while playing, please join our official Discord. We'll try to address any reported issues as soon as we can to ensure a seamless gaming experience for all.

Q: When will the launch discount end?
A: The 18% OFF launch discount, will stay until 8:00 PM PDT on April 3rd.

Q: How long is the playtime of Reverse Collapse expected to be?
A: Gameplay duration varies depending on individual playstyles. Some players prefer to speedrun, while others enjoy leisurely experiencing the plot and collecting items. Considering the challenges of achieving S-rank objectives and uncovering other collectibles and hidden elements, experiencing the complete game content we've designed may take over 100 hours.

Q: What is the difference between the Standard and Deluxe editions?
A: While the Standard Edition contains the base game, the Deluxe Edition elevates your experience with exclusive perks, including:
A 70-page digital artbook showcasing intricate designs; 
A 65-track soundtrack composed by international talents;
7 stunning outfits for our main characters; 
Additionally, helpful bonus in-game item bundles will be deployed at the start of each chapter for the players who own the Deluxe Edition.

Q: Can I upgrade from the Standard to the Deluxe edition?
A: Unfortunately, platform restrictions prevent simultaneous purchases of both editions. However, players intrigued by the expanded lore and character development can supplement their experience by purchasing the Deluxe Edition upgrade pack and soundtrack separately.


Q: Is Steam Workshop supported at launch?
A: Given the intricate sprite structure and additional code file management requirements, we've opted to prioritize ensuring a stable gaming experience for all players. The game does not support the Steam Workshop feature for now.

Q: What are the system requirements for running Reverse Collapse?
A: Fear not, for Reverse Collapse is optimized to run smoothly on a wide range of hardware configurations, ensuring a seamless experience for all operatives. More details can be found on our Steam store page.

Q: Does Reverse Collapse support controllers and Steam Deck?
A: Yes! Whether you prefer console-style controls or the flexibility of a keyboard and mouse, Reverse Collapse offers full support for Xbox, PS controllers, and Steam Deck.

For more comprehensive FAQ-related information, feel free to take a look at our previous Steam post: [https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1127700/view/6727887174673371580]

Should you have any further queries or insights to share, don't hesitate to reach out. You can connect with us on our official discord and Twitter. Let's embark together on this exhilarating journey!

Furthermore, we've stumbled upon a treasure trove of exquisite fan creations. While we'd love to showcase them all, there's simply too much to cover! We warmly invite you to contribute your findings and creations in the comments section below.

[Fan Art section]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/38ce010369bf5557def1e4c55b3bfe074f210a06.pngBy-@Samsam_S2s

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/a08570487350ee9ff51c9988fb792077d3b3735a.pngBy-@Para919

In closing, we extend our sincere gratitude on behalf of the entire development team. While we've shared a wealth of information, we recognize that our journey continues, and we understand that "Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery" isn't flawless. Nevertheless, it stands as a testament to the dedication and passion poured into it by our team. To those who have stood by us since the days of "Bakery Girl", your patience has not gone unnoticed, and we eagerly await the chance to forge new connections with even more players. Here's to the journey ahead!

notes.title: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery FAQ
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!

Since our last developer's log and the thrilling announcement of our release date, we've been overwhelmed by the outpouring of interest and inquiries from both seasoned operatives and new recruits alike. In response, we've compiled this FAQ to address some of the most common questions and concerns raised by our dedicated community.

Q: What time will the game launch on March 22nd?
A: Reverse Collapse is scheduled for release at precisely 8 PM PDT on March 21st, 11 PM EDT on March 21st, and 4 AM CET on March 22nd.

Q: How long will the launch discount be available?
A: We're offering an 18% OFF discount for the first two weeks post-launch. Grab the Standard Edition for $20.49 USD and the Deluxe Edition for $32.79 USD until April 5th.

Q: What sets apart the Standard Edition from the Deluxe Edition?
A: While the Standard Edition contains the base game, the Deluxe Edition elevates your experience with exclusive perks, including:

 A 56-page digital artbook showcasing intricate designs;

Q: How long is the gameplay experience?

Q: Will the game feature voice acting?

notes.title: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery Coming This June to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Fellow agents! It's that time of year again where we come together and celebrate the anniversary of Girls’ Frontline! Here’s the latest intel about Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery that was revealed during the hot spring livestream:

Steam Next Fest
Last month, we marked the 10th anniversary of the original Bakery Girl and ran an exclusive test for Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. We were absolutely blown away by the support from agents around the world and collected a great deal of feedback and suggestions, which has been tremendously helpful in guiding us make adjustments and optimization.

For those who weren’t selected in the last test, we have some exciting news: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery will be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest this June with a public demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/ffbb6dd0b7f1fad108e1f97caed0d6191d99665e.jpg

Since the initial debut, Reverse Collapse has come a long way. What started out as a simple remake turned into a much more expansive narrative experience as development progressed, which inevitably led to massive overhauls of the level design. We're continuously learning and iterating new ideas, and we are incredibly grateful for your support throughout this process.

We’ve recently been able to finalize the overwhelmingly lengthy script, and the team is now shifting gear towards getting everything ready for release, such as QA testing and some finishing touches. It’s our priority to deliver Reverse Collapse in its best quality at release.

Interested in learning more about the game and upcoming events? Join our official Discord server where we’ll share the latest news and announcements, and there might even be some Discord-exclusive events in the future so don’t miss out!

notes.title: An Update from Sunborn Network on Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery
notes.content:
Dear agents,

First off, we want to thank you for all your support for Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. 

The very first trailer for Reverse Collapse was released over two years ago in 2019, and we have not stopped working on this project since. This is a remaster of our first game, Code Name: Bakery Girl (2013), so it represents something special and meaningful to us. This is also an opportunity for us to make up for our shortcomings as an amateur game developer in our earlier years, so our team really went all-in to infuse the script with elaborate storylines, graphics, characters, levels, and mechanics. We hope that the final product will be presented as an exciting new experience that captures the essence of Code Name: Bakery Girl.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/1348472293c4685946f1d23462a7b3a9c68cebbc.jpg

Beyond the visual update and code optimization, we came up with a lot of new and interesting ideas in the development process for Reverse Collapse, some of which have already debuted during live streams and offline demos, while other core content is still undergoing QA and optimization. Therefore, we have decided to move the release to 2022 so that the team can continue to work on the new content until the entire game is complete and polished.

Below you can learn about the development progress and what we will be working on in the following months:

1. Content and structure adjustments

Reverse Collapse follows the main storyline of Code Name: Bakery Girl (2013), in which the intelligence agency MID of the Antarctic Union carries out Code Name: Bakery in the North Caucasus over the course of two days and one night. It was clear to us that the original script was too short to cover the full extent of this exhilarating mission, so the team has been determined from the very beginning that we would rewrite the script to thoroughly showcase this mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/3f212a08e447d5667440fdbadeb598c695d38c68.png
 ↑ Main Menu of Code Name: Bakery Girl 

While this is the same 2-day mission, the storyline will feature much more content with captivating details. The current, incomplete script, for example, has a word count eight times longer than that of the original.

To make the storyline more elaborate, the director and our designers have gone through many iterations of the script, sometimes overhauling an almost complete concept. The current structure of the storyline has been redesigned based on the Girls’ Frontline franchise and will be completely new upon the release of the game.  

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/76293bd7a8d297986e18d5dd62860c3fc01d9398.png

In addition to remastering the original storyline, during the creative process, the team came up with a new vision for how the script should be presented and eventually decided to pursue it by continuing to finetune the existing script structure. In the meantime, the ever-growing Girls’ Frontline franchise requires that new development is accurately reflected in the script of Reverse Collapse.

Therefore, the team can really make use of the extra time to refine the storyline in Reverse Collapse and connect it to the rest of the Girls’ Frontline universe. We are excited for the new script and its presentation to be a novel and impressive experience for our players.

2. Level diversification

As the storyline became more sophisticated, we had to add many new levels accordingly. Based on how the new script has been structured, the total number of levels in Reverse Collapse will eventually exceed that of the original by several times. Additionally, level placement has been dynamically modified to reflect the script changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/fe943e2fcaeabda59b2d021b3668b1aceaf225e3.png
↑ Level Map from Code Name: Bakery Girl

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/e4c41472ab0d2d9506ed4422f8ecc732e07fcb91.png
↑ Level Map from Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery

Levels are a crucial part of the Code Name: Bakery Girl experience. So, when new levels were introduced, we were met with a lot of new challenges. In order to keep players entertained, we introduced more innovative and elaborate gameplay styles to the levels on top of the existing elimination and stealth modes. Moreover, a diverse selection of S-rank challenges have been integrated into the levels for additional replay value. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/055c277eacd88d47c3ca8862c7f159d0096860b9.png

3. Improving the lore

As promised, our graphics team has created numerous cutscenes to help immerse players into the game’s lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/b2cf9b52abee826550a6285e23c124e3af686af7.png

After multiple rounds of testing and gathering suggestions from both inside and outside of our company, we realized that our static illustrations could not clearly express many key plot points. To help improve the game experience, we decided to combine 2D animations and plot illustrations with dynamic effects to help tell a more vivid story for each of the agents. While these new designs are much more time-consuming to create, especially with all the additional animations and special effects, we are extremely eager to show everyone the results. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/d72bcada4b98ff47046563b76647878f4ecbd636.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/36745c16f6a64abae8b55e4daa764ef15339a684.gif

So that’s where we’re at. The main content for Reverse Collapse has already been developed and we have now entered the home stretch of making final adjustments to the game. We are looking to further optimize every aspect of the game, including an in-depth review of the plot’s logic, a proofread of the plot details, a final optimization of each level, and an improvement to some of our visuals. We hope that Reverse Collapse can become a memorable experience.

Code name: Bakery Girl is a title that contains a lot of history for Mica Team. We hope that Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery can help new and original fans of the title alike to experience the charm of the original game while also introducing everyone to the Girls’ Frontline universe. (The development team behind both games are the same and we hope this game’s heart-felt stories can reach an even larger audience through our efforts.)

A big thank you to you agents for your support and understanding. We look forward to sharing more with everyone again!
